description: Create a short HSK vocabulary quiz (1-10 multiple-choice questions) for a level: meaning, pinyin, fill-in-the-blank, or mixed. Answers are not included; show the questions to the user, collect their choices, then call grade_answers with the quiz_id.

level.description: HSK 3.0 level: 1-6, or "7-9" for the advanced band

topic.description: Optional topic tag, e.g. food or travel

type.description: Question type (default mixed); cloze is fill-in-the-blank

name: practice_quiz
title: Create a vocabulary quiz
